diagnostic.title: Initial assessment
diagnostic.subtitle: Set a starting point for personalized music lessons.
diagnostic.startTitle: Let's get to know your playing
diagnostic.startDescription: Start a diagnostic session. Add a familiar performance if you like before choosing your first study.
diagnostic.intakeDescription: You can add performances and scores or continue straight to choosing a study.
diagnostic.noFilesYet: Performances are optional — you may move straight to choosing a study.
diagnostic.readyDescription: The session is stored and waiting for its first diagnostic task. Task selection comes in the next increment.
diagnostic.noAssessment: No audio has been analyzed and no skill assessments have been made.
diagnostic.chooseStudy: Choose your first diagnostic étude. One provisional original piece is available.
diagnostic.noExercises: No études are available for this instrument yet.
diagnostic.draftWarning: The piece is accepted for the MVP prototype, but fingering and score rendering still require validation.
diagnostic.practiceTips: Start with melody only, then a steady thumb bass. Combine parts at 60–70 BPM before approaching 84 BPM. This is practice, not a graded exam.
diagnostic.tabWarning: Fret positions are shown on an eighth-note grid; use the MusicXML score for exact durations, rests and articulation.
diagnostic.catalogApiMissing: Exercise catalog API not found (HTTP 404). Make sure Spring Boot is running from feature/dev-05b-exercise-catalog rather than an older backend version.
diagnostic.synthesizedExample: This is synthesized guitar, not a teacher performance.
diagnostic.mediaNotInstalled: Preview file has not been installed in this local prototype yet. MusicXML score remains available below.
diagnostic.musicXmlAlternative: If your browser cannot display PDF inline:
diagnostic.recommendationLoading: Matching available studies to your goals...
diagnostic.recommendationUnavailable: Recommendations could not load. The catalog remains available below.
diagnostic.manualChoice: You can change your profile or manually select an exercise from the catalog.

noRecommendation.ALL_STYLES_EXCLUDED: All suitable styles are excluded by preferences.

home.pace: Music you love. Clear steps. At your own pace.
home.restoreError: Could not check the saved lesson. Retry; your data and selection are preserved.

sections.profile: Your instrument, playing technique and the music you enjoy.

attempt.title: My performance
attempt.subtitle: Submit an audio attempt and review your submission history.
attempt.noAiFeedback: Recordings undergo technical file and duration checks only. AI music analysis is not yet connected; performance is not assessed.
attempt.disabledHelp: Uploads are disabled by default because authentication is not yet implemented. For non-personal local test audio only, start the backend with GUITAR_MENTOR_ENABLE_UPLOADS=true.
attempt.fileLimits: MP3, WAV, OGG, WebM or M4A (AAC) · up to 20 MB. Test audio only; do not upload personal recordings.
attempt.commentPlaceholder: For example: I lose the steady bass in bars 5–8
attempt.uploaded: Attempt saved. No performance assessment is currently available.
attempt.sizeError: Audio must be nonempty and no larger than 20 MB.
attempt.formatError: MP3, WAV, OGG and WebM only.
attempt.receivedUnassessed: Audio received · assessment not yet available
attempt.micPrivacy: Your browser will request permission when you press Start. The recording remains in the browser until you submit it. Use test audio only for this MVP.
attempt.micUnsupported: This browser does not support a compatible recording format. Upload MP3/WAV/OGG/WebM/M4A instead.
attempt.recorderError: Recording failed. Check your microphone and retry.
attempt.recorderEmpty: The recording is empty. Please try again.
attempt.microphoneDenied: Could not access the microphone. Check browser permissions and the selected device.
attempt.micLevelHint: The meter reacts to incoming sound in real time. It tests the microphone, not your playing.
attempt.micLevelUnavailable: The input level meter is unavailable in this browser; recording may still work.
attempt.statusProcessed: File integrity verified · musical assessment not yet available
attempt.failedMissing: The file was not found in local storage
attempt.failedSize: Stored file size does not match
attempt.failedGeneric: The file could not be checked. Contact the local prototype administrator
attempt.failedDuration: Audio is longer than 2 minutes. Please submit a shorter attempt.
attempt.failedProbe: Audio inspection is unavailable: the server needs ffprobe (FFmpeg).
attempt.failedExpired: Unprocessed recording expired under the retention policy.
attempt.mediaDeleted: Source recording deleted; history and results have been kept.
attempt.failedInterrupted: Technical processing was interrupted repeatedly. Please submit a new attempt.
attempt.invalidAudioContent: Audio could not be recognized: its content does not match the file format. Choose a valid MP3, WAV, OGG, WebM or M4A (AAC).
attempt.invalidUpload: The file was rejected. Check its format and size, then try again.
attempt.uploadDisabled: Uploads are currently disabled. Use local test mode only.
attempt.uploadNetworkError: Could not connect to the server. Check your connection and try again.
attempt.uploadServerError: The server could not accept this recording. Please retry.
attempt.historyLoadError: Could not load attempt history. Refresh the page and check the connection.
attempt.metronomePracticeTip: You can record while playing to the metronome. Use headphones to avoid speaker clicks being captured by the microphone.

evidence.heading: My performances
evidence.description: Add a familiar piece before diagnostic exercises. You can skip this step.
evidence.disabled: Uploads are disabled in this local prototype. You can continue without a recording.
evidence.title: Piece title
evidence.titleInvalid: Enter a piece title (up to 200 characters).
evidence.limits: MP3, WAV, OGG, WebM, M4A (AAC) · up to 20 MiB / 120 seconds. Score: one PDF, JPG or PNG up to 10 MiB.
evidence.saved: Performance saved. You may add another or continue.
evidence.empty: No recordings yet. This will not lower your skill level.
evidence.sizeError: One of the files is too large.
evidence.deleted: Original file deleted according to retention policy; history remains.
evidence.notAssessed: No musical skill assessment has been made.
evidence.confirmDiscard: You have an unsaved performance. Leave this page and discard the draft?
evidence.waitBeforeLeave: Stop recording or finish/cancel the upload before leaving.
evidence.uploadCancelledRetry: Upload canceled. Files and request ID remain for a safe retry. Editing files or fields creates a new submission.
evidence.payloadMismatch: This request ID already belongs to a different performance. Your draft remains. Edit a field or reselect a file to start a new submission.

metronome.title: Metronome
metronome.description: Flexible metronome: choose meter, tempo and beat accents.
metronome.recommended: Tempo from this exercise; changes only affect playback.
metronome.invalidBpm: Enter an integer BPM between 20 and 240.
metronome.unavailable: Audio output is unavailable. Check your device and try again.
metronome.warning: You can keep the metronome playing while recording a practice take. Use headphones to reduce click bleed into the microphone. The metronome does not sync with MP3 or analyze your playing.
metronome.confirmReset: Reset will restore default settings and delete saved presets. Continue?
metronome.confirmResetCorrupt: Reset will replace corrupted local data with defaults. Continue?
metronome.selectBeatForVolume: Select beat to adjust its volume (without changing accent)
metronome.userMeterWarning: User-defined meter — check against the exercise sheet music.
metronome.storeFailure: Could not save preferences in this browser. The metronome can continue playing.
metronome.tapCount: Taps: {count}. Tap at least four times to calculate tempo.
metronome.invalidConfig: Check the meter, groups, tempo and volume levels.
metronome.invalidGroups: Groups must be positive numbers that add up to the meter numerator.
metronome.invalidPreset: Check the preset name and settings (20 presets maximum).
metronome.silent: All beats are muted: the visual metronome continues.
metronome.confirmPreset: Confirm changes to the selected preset?
metronome.pending: New settings will start at the next bar.
metronome.editTempo: Tap the number to enter BPM
metronome.beatHelp: Tap a beat: ● strong · ◐ medium · ○ weak · × mute

tuner.title: Guitar tuner
tuner.instructions: Start tuning and pluck one open string. Auto mode selects it for you; tap a string below for manual mode.
tuner.noSignal: No stable signal — check input level and noise
tuner.privacy: Audio is analyzed locally, never recorded or uploaded. A4 = 440 Hz.
tuner.denied: Microphone access denied. Allow it in site settings and retry.
tuner.failed: Could not start tuner. Check your microphone.
tuner.unsupported: Use a Web Audio browser with a microphone over HTTPS or localhost.
tuner.recorderActive: A performance recording is active. Stop it before tuning; your draft is safe.
tuner.manualHint: Or tap a string to select it manually
tuner.holding: Last reliable reading — listening for the string…
tuner.autoUncertain: No clear open string — try again or choose one manually
tuner.standard: Standard · E A D G B E
tuner.dropD: Drop D · D A D G B E
tuner.openG: Open G · D G D G B D

learning.title: Feedback and decision
learning.technicalFailure: Technical processing failed; this is not a musical assessment
learning.processing: Recording is processing. No musical assessment yet
learning.noAssessment: File processed technically. Musical assessment is not available yet
learning.confirmComplete: Finish this assignment? Outstanding feedback will remain and unverified skills will not be considered mastered.
learning.conflict: Assignment has changed. Review updated data before choosing again.
learning.nextUnavailable: Assignment completed. Automatic next lesson is not available yet.

errors.NETWORK_UNAVAILABLE: Cannot reach server. Check your connection.
errors.NO_ATTEMPT: At least one attempt is required

learning.skillEvidenceHelp: Individual criterion results are not the same as a confirmed skill level. Learner self-assessment is stored separately.
learning.uploadClosed: Assignment completed. New attempts cannot be uploaded; history and feedback remain available.
